A '''panic ring''' was a small device that would continuously broadcast an encrypted emergency signal to authorities if the wearer pressed a small button. It was usually hidden in a large ornate ring. It had a range of 100 kilometers.

[[Enneth Holkin]], protocol aide to co-[[Chief of State (Corellia)|Chief of State]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] [[Denjax Teppler]], wore one during [[Unification Summit]] in [[43 ABY]].
